name: Arugula Breakfast Salad with Fried Egg, Prosciutto, Cheddar & Croutons

instructions.primary_message: Cut bread into 1-inch cubes. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 slices whole grain bread
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch garlic powder
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add bread cubes and cook, stirring occasionally, until the croutons are golden and toasted, 4-5 minutes. Return to the bowl. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, place additional oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 eggs
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the eggs are cooking, wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry arugula (skip if it came pre-washed). Add to the bowl.
Small dice cheese. Add to the bowl, along with the croutons, and toss to combine the salad.
Chop or tear prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with prosciutto and eggs. Enjoy!
